description: A Python source file containing functions and classes related to behavioral time budget analysis in a behavioral observation research software. Includes functions for initializing behavior data, calculating statistics, generating synthetic time budgets, and analyzing time budget data from observations.

classes.name: StdevFunc
classes.description: A class to enable standard deviation calculation in SQL queries, maintaining running mean and sum of squares for variance calculation.

methods.name: default_value(ethogram: dict, behavior_code: str, param)
methods.description: Returns a default value for behavior duration based on behavior type and parameters, handling point events and state events.

methods.name: dict init_behav_modif(ethogram: dict, selected_subjects: list, distinct_behav_modif: list, parameters: dict)
methods.description: Initializes a nested dictionary with subjects, behaviors/modifiers, and associated parameters with default values.

methods.name: dict init_behav_modif_bin(ethogram: dict, selected_subjects: list, distinct_behav_modif: list, parameters: dict)
methods.description: Initializes a nested dictionary for behavior/modifier parameters, similar to init_behav_modif but structured for binary modifiers.

methods.name: synthetic_time_budget_bin(pj: dict, selected_observations: list, parameters_obs: dict)
methods.description: Creates a synthetic time budget divided into time bins, calculating durations, counts, and proportions per behavior, modifier, and subject.

methods.name: synthetic_time_budget(pj: dict, selected_observations: list, parameters_obs: dict)
methods.description: Generates a synthetic overall time budget from observations, integrating database query results and calculating behavior durations and occurrences.

methods.name: Tuple[list,dict] time_budget_analysis( ethogram: dict, cursor, selected_observations: list, parameters: dict, by_category: bool = False )
methods.description: Analyzes behavioral time budget data across observations, grouping by behavior and computing occurrence counts, durations, and inter-event intervals.
